prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning beds or spray (airbrush/sunless) tanning — and which part of Columbus (zip or neighborhood) do you prefer? If you tell me that I can give specific salon suggestions.

Meanwhile, here are quick tips to find the best salon and what to look for:

How to choose
- Decide spray vs. UV: spray gives an immediate safe-looking tan without UV risk; UV beds carry skin‑cancer risk and require careful limits.
- Read recent Google and Yelp reviews for cleanliness, staff professionalism, and consistency of results.
- Look for certifications/training for technicians (especially for spray tanning).
- Ask about equipment age and brands (newer beds and high-end spray machines give more even results).
- Check hygiene: disposable nose plugs/goggles, clean rooms, changing areas.
- Ask about products used (hypoallergenic, paraben-free, DHA concentration) and view before/after photos.
- Compare pricing and packages; many salons offer loyalty discounts or memberships.

Questions to ask the salon
- For spray: experience level of technician, custom shade matching, wait time to shower, instructions for pre/post care.
- For UV: exact lamp types and session length recommendations, staff supervision, tanning plan for your skin type.

Safety notes
- If you’re concerned about health, choose spray tanning or gradual self-tanning lotions.
- If using UV, limit sessions, use eye protection, and follow staff guidance for your skin type.

If you tell me your preferred type (spray vs UV) and where in Columbus you are, I’ll suggest several local salons and what to ask them.
